story1.title: Rosie Brings a Basket to the River
pages: Rosie is a small rabbit. She puts on her yellow coat.
She peeks through the green grass.
She sees a duck and a frog. They play all day.

steps.spoken_page1: Rosie is a small banana. She puts on her coat.

story2.title: Rosie Finds Friends by the Water
pages: Rosie is a small grey rabbit in a yellow raincoat.
She hops to the soft river bank.
She sees fish and frogs in the water.
She wiggles her nose at a duck.
Then she hops home happy and dry.
